name: こぐまの魔法使い
notes: Codex imagegen reference → local TRELLIS-2 dense reconstruction → measured QEM and feature-preserving Taubin surface repair. Source geometry, UV and albedo lineage retained; no procedural model replacement.
22 bones including hand grip sockets; normalized maximum-four influences; nine in-place motions. Locomotion follows measured stance speed.
Opaque source atlas packed as baseline JPEG with measured PSNR >40 dB; mesh, rig and animation buffer views remain byte-identical to the preceding revision.

Prototype limits: hair/fur remains a solid reconstructed surface, and there are no separate finger or facial expression rigs. Layered clothing retains small shoulder/waist deformation at extreme poses.
Original little bear mage, 0.78 m tall, moss-green capelet and waist wrap. Dedicated short-limb locomotion and two-paw cast at 400 ms; game walking 0.6 m/s and running 1.8 m/s.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction and measured reduction.
